body: The W4 plan said the S7 landing page (templates/invite.html) should link to the web app's redeem route for desktop users ("the landing page links here when opened on desktop — coordinate copy with S7"). Never implemented: the page offers only an Android intent:// link (useless on desktop browsers) and paste-the-code instructions. Since the web client is served same-origin by the blueprint, the fix is one relative link in the valid-token branch: Redeem in your browser (plus a test asserting it renders only for valid tokens, and only when the web client is being served — pass a flag from create_blueprint, it knows serve_web_client). Depends on the web login-destination ticket for the logged-out case to work end-to-end; link them.
title: Invite landing page: add the planned 'Redeem in browser' link
